creator: bengusberg
title: Prompt Claude with the Minto Pyramid Principle (conclusion first, three reasons, then evidence) so all docs and emails read like consultant writing

tools.name: Minto Pyramid Principle
tools.detail: Writing framework by ex-McKinsey consultant Barbara Minto

tools.name: Claude
tools.detail: Add the prompt to custom instructions

claims: Every McKinsey consultant learns this one framework
Claude by default gives fluff first and the conclusion last; people do not read to the end
Creator intro: Stanford founder, AI startup, raised $4 million
how_to_steps: Structure: 1) start with the conclusion, 2) give three supporting reasons, 3) end with supporting evidence/data
Use the prompt on anything you write (prompt text not shown legibly; paraphrase: 'Rewrite this using the Minto Pyramid Principle: conclusion first, three reasons, then evidence')
Optionally add it to Claude custom instructions so every output follows it
on_screen_only: Pyramid diagram: 'Main Recommendation/Goal/Idea' at top -> three 'Supporting Arguments' -> 'Supporting Data / Insights / Conclusions' under each
cta: Try it and let me know what you write; follow for more

relevance.why: Useful for investor updates, customer emails, PRDs and docs a time-poor founder writes with Claude; not a coding workflow.

implement_score.why: Ten-minute win: add a 'writing' skill or CLAUDE.md rule enforcing conclusion-first, three reasons, evidence last for any doc/email output.

verify: Exact prompt text was not shown; write your own
Minto's book 'The Pyramid Principle' is the primary source if deeper structure (MECE grouping) is wanted
